claims.text: Two-choice odour discrimination with a single reward-contingency reversal; trials to criterion (8 of 10 correct) compared between 24 h sleep-deprived and rested mice (n = 16 per group).
c-Fos immunostaining in lateral orbitofrontal cortex 90 min after the reversal session; positive-cell density compared between groups.
c-Fos density cannot distinguish reduced orbitofrontal activity from reduced task engagement; the design bears on prediction p2 only correlationally.
